Hub/System/Illustration and patterns
System

Illustration and patterns.

Small spot illustrations and quiet background patterns, built only from the two shape families of the brand: the Quadrant Kit and the capsule. Photography carries people; illustration carries ideas such as delivery, privacy and a provider's review.

StyleSpot illustrationsPatternsWhere to useIn useDo and don'tSpecOpen items
Proposed

A first set for review: six spot illustrations and five patterns, each pattern in a light and a dark version. The shapes and colours follow the Brand page (R-31 to R-33). Every capsule line is drawn to R-109, and a spot or a pattern counts as one shape on its surface (R-106).

The illustration style.

Geometric, flat and few. Every illustration could be cut out of the kit with scissors.

Kit pieces only.

Square, Quarter, Half, Circle, Arch, Arc and the capsule (Split, Outline, Vertical). No oval, no soft-cornered rectangle, no freehand curve (R-31).

Flat colour.

Website palette only: Deep Teal, Blue, Blue-dark, Green, the washes, Mist and Paper. No gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. Never Yellow, never the logo colours (R-11, R-84).

The capsule line of R-109.

Every capsule line is 0.85% of the capsule's length as rendered, never under 1.5px, so in spots and patterns it is 1.5. A capsule that needs weight takes a fill, never a thicker line. The capsule keeps the divider and the logo's own shape: the long half 55% of the length, the short half taller (R-105). Never a symmetric pill.

Few pieces.

At most four kinds of piece and three colours plus Paper in one illustration. If it needs more, it is a photo, not an illustration.

No people, no bodies.

No figures, faces, hands or anatomy. People appear only in photography (R-37).

No medicine scenes.

No loose or spilling pills, syringes, lab glass or before and after (R-38). The capsule is a brand shape, not a dose.

Spot illustrations.

Six spots for empty states, emails and help pages. SVG on a transparent ground, for Paper, Mist or Card. Two placed sizes, one file each, so the line renders at 1.5 at both: 160 on desktop (spot-*.svg) and 96 on mobile and in small slots (spot-*-96.svg). Never scale a file, and never larger than the text block beside it.

Background patterns.

Five tileable patterns, each with a light version for Paper or Mist and a dark version for Deep Teal. Low contrast on purpose: a pattern is texture, never a message. The files are transparent; the ground colour comes from the layout, so tiles join without seams. A pattern counts as one shape and leaves no room for a second on its surface (R-106).

Where patterns go.

A pattern fills a surface that carries no reading. Copy always sits on a plain area beside it (R-33).

Use a pattern on
  • Packaging inner surfaces: inside the lid, sleeves, tissue, inserts with no text.
  • Email header strips, above the logo and never behind it.
  • Social backgrounds, in the zone with no copy.
  • Video end plates and event backdrops, around the logo's clear space.
Never use a pattern
  • Behind body text, headlines, prices, forms or safety information.
  • On product labels or the outside of the shipping box (R-89).
  • Behind the logo or inside its clear space (R-92).
  • More than one pattern on a surface, or a pattern and a spot illustration together.
  • On a website fold that already carries a shape: a pattern counts as one shape and leaves no room for a second (R-106, R-111). Patterns on website pages at all are still open (see below).

In use.

Four sketches of the rules above. Copy and patterns never overlap.

Do and don't.

Do: build from the kit.

Every piece is a Quadrant Kit piece or a capsule, axis-aligned at rest.

Don't: draw new shapes.

No ovals, blobs, waves, stars or rounded boxes.

Do: keep a pattern quiet.

Low contrast on its ground, one pattern per surface.

Don't: put copy on a pattern.

No headline, price, disclaimer or logo on top of it (R-33).

Do: let photography carry people.

Illustration shows objects and ideas: a box, a lock, a message.

Don't: draw people or bodies.

No figures, hands, silhouettes or anatomy, not even abstract ones.

Do: use the capsule as a shape.

Outline, split or vertical, as on the Brand page.

Don't: spill or count capsules.

No piles, doses or pills falling out of a bottle (R-38).

Spec.

All files in assets/patterns/, made by build_patterns.py, which reads every colour from tokens.json. Capsule lines follow R-109: 1.5 as rendered.

Patterns tile at 1x only: a 2x tile would double the line past R-109. Mobile: the same tiles at 1x, so more of the rhythm shows on a wide screen than on a phone. In print, export the tile as vector and repeat it at its own size in the layout tool.
